app.name: Tower Defense
app.long_description:
Build arrow, cannon and frost towers along the road and stop 20 waves of slimes, bats, golems and bosses from reaching your keep.
Controls (Classic Controller): D-Pad: move cursor A: build / upgrade B: sell L / R: change tower X: call next wave Y: fast forward +: pause -: toggle 16:9 / 4:3 screen mode HOME: exit
